configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: accountId
configurable_props.label: Account ID
configurable_props.description: ID of account you are using to make the payment e.g. 294b1dc5-cc47-2afc-7ec8-64990b8761b8. This account needs to be either an account of type BANK or have enable payments to this accounts switched on (see [GET Accounts](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/Accounts)) . See the edit account screen of your Chart of Accounts in Xero if you wish to enable payments for an account other than a bank account

configurable_props.name: accountCode
configurable_props.label: Account Code
configurable_props.description: Code of account you are using to make the payment e.g. 001 ( note: *not all accounts have a code value*)

configurable_props.name: invoiceId
configurable_props.label: Invoice ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the invoice you are applying payment to e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9

configurable_props.name: creditNoteId
configurable_props.label: Credit Note ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the credit note you are applying payment to e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9

configurable_props.name: prepaymentId
configurable_props.label: Prepayment ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the prepayment you are applying payment to e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9

configurable_props.name: overpaymentId
configurable_props.label: Overpayment ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the overpayment you are applying payment to e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9

configurable_props.name: invoiceNumber
configurable_props.label: Invoice Number
configurable_props.description: Number of invoice you are applying payment to e.g. INV-4003

configurable_props.name: creditNoteNumber
configurable_props.label: Credit Note Number
configurable_props.description: Number of credit note you are applying payment to e.g. INV-4003

configurable_props.name: date
configurable_props.label: Date
configurable_props.description: Date the payment is being made (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. 2009-09-06

configurable_props.name: currencyRate
configurable_props.label: Currency Rate
configurable_props.description: Exchange rate when payment is received. Only used for non base currency invoices and credit notes e.g. 0.7500

configurable_props.name: amount
configurable_props.label: Amount
configurable_props.description: The amount of the payment. Must be less than or equal to the outstanding amount owing on the invoice e.g. 200.00

configurable_props.name: reference
configurable_props.label: Reference
configurable_props.description: An optional description for the payment e.g. Direct Debit

configurable_props.name: isReconciled
configurable_props.label: Is Reconciled
configurable_props.description: A boolean indicating whether the payment has been reconciled.
